item.description:
Creedence Clearwater Revival [Travelin' Band] - Live at the Royal Albert Hall 1970 [Blu-ray] (2022)



Creedence Clearwater Revival - "At The Royal Albert Hall" [Super Deluxe Boxset] [2 CD/2 LP/Blu-ray] More than 50 years after the legendary 1970 show, Creedence Clearwater Revival At The Royal Albert Hall has been meticulously restored from the original multitrack tapes and restored by Grammy-winning producer Giles Martin and engineer Sam Okell. The setlist includes such classics as "Fortunate Son," "Proud Mary," "Bad Moon Rising," and more. Super Deluxe Boxset contains the concert on 2 LPs cut at half-speed 45 RPM on 180g vinyl, as well as CD. A Blu-ray disc offers the complete Travelin' Band: CCR At Royal Albert Hall film, plus the album in hi-res and Dolby Atmos immersive audio. Bonus CD features music from the film, including formative recordings from the band's earliest incarnations. Housed in an individually numbered 12"x12" box with embossed gold foil detail, this set includes a replica 1970 tour program, 17"x24" poster, and a 16p booklet featuring an excerpt from Bridges' voice-over script, which offers background on their incredible path to the London show. Limited Edition.
